connections.why: The working characteristics of commodities are explained by the science of food
Each commodity group contributes specific nutrients to the diet
Knowledge of nutrients underpins planning healthy, balanced diets
Understanding how cooking changes food guides preparation techniques
The food investigation tests the functional and chemical properties studied here
Dietary requirements inform the choices made when planning and cooking dishes
Provenance and culinary traditions shape food choice and menu planning
Knowing commodities is essential to selecting and preparing ingredients
Preparation and cooking skills are demonstrated in the food preparation assessment
Nutritional knowledge informs the menu chosen for the preparation assessment
Food safety and the science of cooking govern safe, successful practical work
Findings from the investigation can inform choices in the preparation assessment
